subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should OpenClaw support Browserbase session lifecycle as a first-party browser profile driver, wait for a generic browser-backend plugin seam, or reduce the Browserbase docs to a limitation/workaround?
rationale: The fix crosses commercial-service integration policy, browser-control security, credentials, signed URL redaction, config surface, and session cleanup, so automation should not choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Revise Browserbase Driver
options.body: Accept a first-party Browserbase driver only after the open candidate handles credential policy, signed URL redaction, route coverage, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw browser-tool proof.

options.title: Use Generic Backend Seam
options.body: Keep this issue tied to the broader browser-backend/plugin API so Browserbase support can ship outside core once a safe registration contract exists.

options.title: Document Limitation
options.body: Remove or narrow the static Browserbase recommendation until maintainers are ready to support Browserbase Sessions API lifecycle in product code.

recommendation.title: Revise Browserbase Driver
recommendation.body: Accept a first-party Browserbase driver only after the open candidate handles credential policy, signed URL redaction, route coverage, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw browser-tool proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on the browser plugin boundary and the current runtime/docs surface affected by this product decision.
